notes: Values asserted from the config extracted out of the selected pocketchip-rootfs-2026-09-23.tar.gz, not from documentation. Batch 1 selected the September rootfs (kernel 6.12.107-1.31); its extracted config hash and package identity agree with the independently hash-pinned live kernel .deb. The July 6.12.94-1.29 config evidence remains checked in for the documented fallback. These are the NAND/UBI root-mount chain, the documented built-in display bridge chain, and the FEL-installer USB-gadget chain. Panel (CONFIG_DRM_PANEL_SIMPLE=m), PWM backlight (CONFIG_BACKLIGHT_PWM=m), TCA8418 keyboard (CONFIG_KEYBOARD_TCA8418=m) and the sun4i touchscreen (CONFIG_TOUCHSCREEN_SUN4I=m) are modules in this package; whether early module load is sufficient for the PocketCHIP panel is a hardware-validation item.
